retention.rule: an uploaded file is kept while a scheduled post still needs it and deleted the day after the last one is published (a post sent right away counts the same once every network took it); a file no post uses is deleted 7 days after upload (2 days on the Free plan), and an upload never finalized after a day; nothing is kept longer than 30 days unless a scheduled post still waits for it

how: 1) PUT the raw file bytes to upload_url. 2) GET /api/media/finalize?path=<path> to get media_url. 3) pass media_url as video_url or photo_url to /api/post.
